en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup>, whenever a slave of his<sup>asws</sup> died and left relatives, he<sup>asws</sup> would not take anything from his inheritance,
and heasws was saying [33:6] and the possessors of relationships some of them are closer to others’.
en.sarwar: 5. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has narrated the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying that Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, upon the death of his slaves did not take anything from their legacy if they left any relatives, and he would say, ‘
. . . relatives have priority to each other.’”
